description: Site-Shot's own Claude Code plugin: website screenshots for agents, backed by the published site-shot-mcp server.

plugins.name: site-shot
plugins.description: Let Claude Code see public web pages: real Chromium rendering, full-page capture, country proxies, and automatic ad & cookie-banner removal. Runs the published site-shot-mcp package over stdio and needs a Site-Shot API key: a confirmed account's key comes with the free plan: 100 API captures a month (no card; default location or the US only), and paid plans from $5/mo add volume and other countries.
